name: Hand AR Interfaces 2
summary:
Hand AR Interfaces 2 puts instruments where your hands already are.

Not panels floating in a room. Twenty-three separate objects, each drawn on the palm, the
wrist, the forearm, the knuckles, the fingertips or the space between finger and thumb —
seen through passthrough, in your own room, on your own hand.

They have nothing in common but the hand they are worn on. A Victorian brass orrery sits
in your cupped palm with the planets at today's true longitudes. A sextant drawn as a
